<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SupplierOnboarding" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/supplier-onboarding">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierOnboarding">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company (Procurement Team)" processRef="Process_SupplierSelection"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Suppliers / Vendors"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="Send RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Submit proposal" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Event_ProposalsReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierSelection" name="Supplier Selection and Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Supplier need identified"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)" messageRef="Msg_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProposalsReceived" name="Supplier proposals received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ProposalsReceived" messageRef="Msg_Proposal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals on cost, quality and delivery time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitSplit" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" default="Flow_NoVisit"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_VisitsInterviews" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitMerge" name="Evaluation continues"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Analyze and select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract once terms are agreed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExecuteContract" name="Execute contract"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_SupplierOnboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Event_ProposalsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Event_ProposalsReceived" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VisitSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitSplit" targetRef="Task_VisitsInterviews">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${siteVisitOrInterviewRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_VisitsInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoVisit" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitSplit" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="Task_ExecuteContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ExecuteContract" targetRef="EndEvent_SupplierOnboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
